description: This file defines a React component for rendering an error page in the Mattermost web application, handling different error types and verifying signatures for trust.

classes.name: ErrorPage
classes.description: React component for displaying error pages with different error types and optional signature verification.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets the body class to 'sticky error' when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes the 'class' attribute from the body when the component unmounts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the error page UI based on error type and verification status.
